description: This file defines a Mongoose schema for a 'Brand' model in a Node.js application, including fields like name, slug, image, description, status, merchant reference, and timestamps. It also sets up a slug generator plugin with specific options.

classes.name: BrandSchema
classes.description: A Mongoose schema defining the structure of the 'Brand' documents in the database.

methods.name: Mongoose.model
methods.description: Creates and exports the 'Brand' model based on the BrandSchema.
